title: First two months at Nha Trang
description: Larry spent about his first two months in Vietnam at Nha Trang, on the south-central coast: "we were there about 2 months, they didn't know where to put us." Ron Tototz and Parr were there with him. He calls it "the most beautiful place you ever saw."
researchNotes: His words: giscus-vn-0025-c18032317 (2026-08-15, "Oct or Sept of 1964, we were there about 2 months, they didn't know where to put us"), giscus-vn-0025-c18032311 (Parr "was Nha Trang with me" after they landed), giscus-vn-0022-c18032356 (Ron Tototz at the beach hut), giscus-vn-0018-c18415793 (2026-09-12). These recollections are linked to the photographs, not to this entry; the entry shows the photographs. 2026-09-14: relatedPhotos added and the photo number removed from the description. Which facility or unit he was attached to at Nha Trang is not known (data/places/nha-trang.json). The drowned medic is ledger #14 and is not stated here.
